svg.aria-label: Inside orange serve, your Worker calls your Durable Objects, which run as Rivet Actors. RivetKit sends their traces over OTLP to a collector such as Jaeger, Tempo, or Honeycomb, and Prometheus scrapes the runner's metrics endpoint.
